description: Bright designer apartment located on Rue du Louvre, in the heart of Paris between Montorgueil and Palais-Royal. Set in a classic Haussmannian building, it features a spacious living area with a fully equipped open kitchen and three bedrooms, including a suite with a bathtub. Elegant minimalist décor. Ideal location to explore Paris on foot. Perfect for families or business stays.The spaceLocated on Rue du Louvre, between the lively Montorgueil district and the Palais-Royal gardens, this elegant apartment enjoys a highly sought-after central address, ideal for exploring Paris on foot.From the apartment you can easily reach the Louvre Museum, Avenue de l’Opéra, the Bourse de Commerce, the Musée des Arts Décoratifs and the Jeu de Paume. The area is also known for its cafés, restaurants and boutiques.Set on the first French floor of a beautiful Haussmannian building with remarkable and secure common areas, the apartment offers an elegant, comfortable and peaceful setting in the heart of Paris.Recently renovated, it combines classic Parisian architecture with refined contemporary design.The apartment features three bedrooms:• a primary suite with a king-size bed and private bathroom• a bedroom with a queen-size bed and sink• a bedroom with two separate beds and sinkThe latter two bedrooms share a shower room.Each bedroom includes a dressing area and a television, ensuring privacy and comfort for every guest.The bright living space includes a comfortable lounge and a fully equipped open kitchen for six guests, perfect for relaxing after a day exploring Paris.Guest accessFully independent apartment.The property is easily accessible from Paris airports and train stations.
